control_description: SYS-01 roles enforced by the vendor; the dealer has full control all year; family members are laptop administrators

remediation: Dealer viewer role and service windows; separate laptop accounts (POAM-003)

control_description: Pump house and barn padlocked; pivot panel cabinet locked; laptop in the home office

remediation: POL-01 8.6 procedure and first clean-up

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Router blocks inbound traffic, but customer Wi-Fi, the laptop, and the pump controller share one network
gap: Public Wi-Fi reaches the pump controller
remediation: Guest isolation; separate pump house network (POAM-004)

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: Encrypted SaaS traffic and card data; files move from the tractor display and drone by USB stick; W-9 scans in a consumer account
remediation: Scan every stick; delete W-9 scans after entry (POL-01 8.2, 9.3)

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: Built-in antivirus detected and quarantined the test file on download and from a USB stick

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Automatic updates on laptop, phone, and tablet; router firmware never updated; OT firmware never checked
